binary.physical_authority: Copied local inode SHA/physical bookends only; archive metadata is not held-FD container-source identity/every-file image attestation.

inspection.meaning: Mount-list order variance retained explicitly. No old failed attempt replay/adoption or field omission.

requirements_before_ELF_data_interpretat: Prepare a NEW stdlib-only binary data parser and separately implemented independent fold, with exact source/invocation/resource review BEFORE use. Bind callback.bin and the independent proof by complete SHA/size and held/named decimal physical identities, two full reads and later bookend pass.

Read the official ELF data layout specification before implementation. Derive magic/class/encoding/version/type/machine and numeric header fields from exact bytes; never infer architecture or ELF validity from the filename.

Bound every offset/count/entry-width/addition/multiplication and file-backed span against exact216280B. Handle or explicitly refuse extended numbering and non-file-backed sections; no silent table truncation. Preserve raw field bytes and exact numeric representations.

Retain complete bounded program/section/dynamic string declarations in pages <=262144B as needed; bind full ordered tables and full relevant raw-span hashes for independent reconstruction. Treat all strings as data, not file paths to open or shell arguments.

If dynamic dependency strings are parsed, validate terminated strings and virtual-address-to-file mapping against exact appropriate file-backed segment spans. Report declarations only; no library search/resolution/origin/runtime binding inferred.
Keep ordinary262144B input/output/file/wire bounds. No ctypes/dlopen, native calls, package import, code compilation of native bytes, ldd/readelf execution or container launch.

A valid small ELF or DT_NEEDED list alone does not establish native callable/global/type provenance, actual dependency origins, package/runtime versions, callback allocation, Arrow defaults/pools, model/RAM or full import closure.
